title: kg_hooks.new_lanes judges a merge commit by diff-tree names alone, so a changed kb gitlink counts as a code path and the pre-push hook refuses a merge that was content before the gitlink fix
goal: the merge-commit branch of kg_hooks.new_lanes leaves a kb submodule root's gitlink out as kblane.commit_paths does
repro_reason: needs a merge commit that changes a gitlink under kb; the planted input is in the notes
notes: SP-mut2pmu3 review gap 6 (S3). kg_hooks.py:87 (new_lanes, merge-commit branch) feeds diff-tree --name-only -c to paths_lane; path_lane no longer calls a bare kb/<name> content, only commit_paths strips the gitlink, so a merge whose changes hold a kb gitlink is now a code path and the hook refuses a merge that was content before. Fix: filter the gitlink in that branch too (a kblane helper both call).
